precepts.label: Mark 11:4-7
precepts.why:
“Rejoice greatly, O daughter of Zion; shout, O daughter of Jerusalem: behold, thy King cometh unto thee”. We have to believe our king is coming. He “is just, and having salvation; lowly, and riding upon an ass, and upon a colt the foal of an ass.”

Mark shows the history of what Zechariah was prophesying: “And they went their way, and found the colt tied by the door without in a place where two ways met; and they loose him. And certain of them that stood there said unto them, What do ye, loosing the colt? And they said unto them even as Jesus had commanded: and they let them go. And they brought the colt to Jesus, and cast their garments on him; and he sat upon him.”

So when people say Christ isn't mentioned in the Old Testament, shut up; you don't know what you're talking about. Zechariah saw the King of Zion riding upon the colt, and Mark records Christ sitting upon that colt. He is our King, just and having salvation, and he is coming to the daughter of Zion.

precepts.label: Psalms 72:8
precepts.why:
Zechariah says the King “shall speak peace unto the heathen: and his dominion shall be from sea even to sea, and from the river even to the ends of the earth.” David says the same: “He shall have dominion also from sea to sea, and from the river unto the ends of the earth.” And he reads on: “They that dwell in the wilderness shall bow before him; and his enemies shall lick the dust.”

They are scared of the saying from the river to the sea. Well, that's in the Bible too. And it is not just that little area. It is from sea to sea, meaning the whole planet earth is ours. When we went into the land, the Lord gave us that portion according to the number of the children of Israel, but the whole earth really belongs to us, to the ends of the earth.

In that day “I will cut off the chariot from Ephraim, and the horse from Jerusalem, and the battle bow shall be cut off”, meaning we would have no military during that time. The King's dominion is our defence, and his enemies shall lick the dust.

precepts.label: Hebrews 13:20
precepts.why:
Zechariah says, “As for thee also, by the blood of thy covenant I have sent forth thy prisoners out of the pit wherein is no water.” What is the blood of thy covenant? Hebrews shows it: “Now the God of peace, that brought again from the dead our Lord Jesus, that great shepherd of the sheep, through the blood of the everlasting covenant”.

The blood of the everlasting covenant is Christ dying on the cross. By that blood God sends forth his prisoners out of the pit.

If you didn't know it, this is the pit. Like it says, yea, though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death; Ezekiel 37 calls America the valley of dry bones. This is the pit, and “no water” means there is no truth here.

Then Zechariah says, “Turn you to the strong hold, ye prisoners of hope”. We are the prisoners of hope, and the stronghold is the Lord, this Bible: “The Lord is good, a strong hold in the day of trouble; and he knoweth them that trust in him.” By Christ's blood we are brought out of the pit to the stronghold.

precepts.label: Nahum 1:7
precepts.why:
Zechariah says “Turn you to the strong hold, ye prisoners of hope.” Nahum tells us what that stronghold is: “The Lord is good, a strong hold in the day of trouble; and he knoweth them that trust in him.” The stronghold is the Lord, and that means this Bible.

The verse before in Zechariah speaks of the pit “wherein is no water”, meaning there is no truth. That pit is America, the valley of dry bones of Ezekiel 37. Out of that pit, the prisoners are told to turn to the stronghold.

So turning to the stronghold is turning to the Lord and his word. He is good, he is our strong hold in the day of trouble, and he knows them that trust in him. We are the prisoners of hope, and the Bible calls us that.

precepts.label: Proverbs 1:23
precepts.why:
Zechariah says turn you to the stronghold; Proverbs says “Turn you at my reproof: behold, I will pour out my spirit unto you, I will make known my words unto you.” God's reproof is his laws.

So there is a stipulation to get God's Holy Spirit: you must turn at God's reproof. The laws come before the spirit. Only when you turn to his laws will he pour out his spirit on you and make known his words to you.

That is why all these dumb Christians that say they have the Holy Spirit and won't keep a commandment do not have it. They have Satan on them. Turning to the stronghold, for us prisoners of hope, means turning at his reproof and keeping his laws.

precepts.label: John 14:15-18
precepts.why:
More proof that the spirit comes after the laws: Christ said the same thing. “If ye love me, keep my commandments. And I will pray the Father, and he shall give you another Comforter, that he may abide with you for ever”.

Who is that Comforter? “Even the Spirit of truth; whom the world cannot receive, because it seeth him not, neither knoweth him: but ye know him; for he dwelleth with you, and shall be in you.” Then Christ says, “I will not leave you comfortless: I will come to you.” He is letting us know he is the Comforter. It ain't Muhammad. Christ is the Comforter; he is the Holy Spirit.

So the one who turns to the stronghold and keeps the commandments is the one who receives Christ, the Spirit of truth. Those who claim the Holy Spirit and keep no commandment do not have him.

People don't reject the truth because it is false; they reject it because it is uncomfortable. Black and Latino people hate the discomfort of change. But knowledge you won't act on just sits there and becomes nothing, like people who say they want to lose weight, know what to do, and won't do a damn thing.

precepts.label: 1 Peter 3:19-20
precepts.why:
Why does Zechariah call us prisoners of hope? Peter says Christ “went and preached unto the spirits in prison”. When Christ came, he preached to the spirits in prison. That's us: our mothers and fathers, our sons and daughters. We are in a spiritual prison.

When Rome was dominating us, that was a prison. We didn't have free rule; Rome was over us.

Those spirits in prison are the ones “Which sometime were disobedient, when once the longsuffering of God waited in the days of Noah, while the ark was a preparing, wherein few, that is, eight souls were saved by water.” That disobedient people is you and me. We are the prisoners, and our hope is in the stronghold.

precepts.label: Isaiah 61:1
precepts.why:
Isaiah shows what Christ was sent to do for those prisoners: “The Spirit of the Lord God is upon me; because the Lord hath anointed me to preach good tidings unto the meek; he hath sent me to bind up the brokenhearted, to proclaim liberty to the captives, and the opening of the prison to them that are bound”.

We are in a prison house, and we are bound in sin. Christ is anointed to proclaim liberty to us captives and to open the prison to us that are bound.

That is why we are prisoners of hope: the prison is real, but the one anointed to open it has come, and we are told to turn to him, the stronghold.

precepts.label: John 8:32-34
precepts.why:
Christ said, “And ye shall know the truth, and the truth shall make you free.” They answered him, “We be Abraham’s seed, and were never in bondage to any man: how sayest thou, Ye shall be made free?” So they knew being made free referred to being in bondage. They said, we were never slaves.

They couldn't see that Rome was over them. They were paying taxes to Rome and were oblivious to it, because they were rich and wealthy.

So watch what Christ says: “Verily, verily, I say unto you, Whosoever committeth sin is the servant of sin.” He took it down a level: you won't understand what I just said, but you are a servant. You are bound in your sins.

That is the prison of the prisoners of hope: bound under the nations and bound in sin. The truth, turning to the stronghold, is what makes us free.

precepts.label: Romans 6:12-13
precepts.why:
If sin is the prison, Paul tells us how to walk out of it: “Let not sin therefore reign in your mortal body, that ye should obey it in the lusts thereof.” Don't let sin reign, meaning rule, within you.

“Neither yield ye your members as instruments of unrighteousness unto sin: but yield yourselves unto God, as those that are alive from the dead, and your members as instruments of righteousness unto God.”

Our bodies must be vessels of righteousness, used for the commandments of God and nothing else. That is how the prisoners of hope turn to the stronghold: no longer servants of sin, but instruments of righteousness unto God.

precepts.label: Isaiah 61:7-9
precepts.why:
Zechariah says “even to day do I declare that I will render double unto thee”. Isaiah shows what that double is: “For your shame ye shall have double”. The shame we have suffered in captivity after captivity, we shall have double for it.

“and for confusion they shall rejoice in their portion”, because we are a confused people; take a look at TikTok and Instagram. “therefore in their land they shall possess the double: everlasting joy shall be unto them.” God says “I the Lord love judgment, I hate robbery for burnt offering; and I will direct their work in truth, and I will make an everlasting covenant with them.”

Watch the double we are going to get: “And their seed shall be known among the Gentiles, and their offspring among the people: all that see them shall acknowledge them, that they are the seed which the Lord hath blessed.” We have never experienced that. Imagine walking down the street and everybody knows your kids' names and moves the hell out of their way: that's brother so-and-so's kid. All people are going to know our children. That's double.

Write down the chain of events: awakening, which is us waking up; followed by tribulation, and we are between those now; World War III; Armageddon in the midst of that war, where Christ makes his advent; deliverance; wilderness; then kings and priests, rulership.

precepts.label: Malachi 4:1
precepts.why:
The Lord said, “I have created the waster to destroy.” What weapon at that time could have been called the waster? Nothing. Zechariah describes it: “Their flesh shall consume away while they stand upon their feet, and their eyes shall consume away in their holes, and their tongue shall consume away in their mouth.” Could anybody then fathom a weapon that did those things? Malachi shows the day it is fulfilled: “For, behold, the day cometh, that shall burn as an oven”.

The prophets did not know about nuclear weapons and atoms back then. They got these visions and explained them the best they could, and the best way to say it was: the waster. God put it on man to make that instrument, and there will be a day when that plague is fulfilled.

“And all the proud, yea, and all that do wickedly, shall be stubble”: not just Esau and the other nations, but even rebellious Israel, the ones that do not repent. “And the day that cometh shall burn them up, saith the Lord of hosts, that it shall leave them neither root nor branch.” When you burn something it leaves ashes, but with this waster nothing remains. They show dramatic images, but the body does not survive that heat; whatever ash there is is blown into the atmosphere. You are totally gone.

And here is the beauty of it: God put it in their spirit to make that thing, and he is going to use that same thing to end them. The weapon they feel gave them their power, authority and respect, he will turn against them.

precepts.label: 2 Peter 3:9
precepts.why:
Zechariah's plague and Malachi's day that burns as an oven are coming, so why has it not come yet? Peter answers: “The Lord is not slack concerning his promise, as some men count slackness; but is longsuffering to us-ward, not willing that any should perish, but that all should come to repentance.”

The only reason it tarries is that the Lord is waiting for us. It is not really a set time the way we see it: the time is when that set number is sealed, and God knows when that will be. That is why there is no date for it that we are aware of.

“But the day of the Lord will come as a thief in the night”: when you least suspect it, that is when it comes. “In the which the heavens shall pass away with a great noise, and the elements shall melt with fervent heat”. In those days they could not imagine what that sounded like; it sounded terrifying. Now that we understand it, it is no less terrifying, because we know what those nukes can do.

The Lord stays their hand enough that they do not want to use them. They sign treaties against nuclear proliferation because they know if one fires, the other fires back, and it's a wrap, a zero-sum game, the end of the world as they know it. It is like the game Civilization: it lets you build and use a nuke, but once you use it the game ends, because you destroyed the whole earth. The Lord holds it back while he waits for his people to come to repentance.

precepts.label: 2 Peter 3:12
precepts.why:
Peter says, “Seeing then that all these things shall be dissolved, what manner of persons ought ye to be in all holy conversation and godliness, Looking for and hasting unto the coming of the day of God, wherein the heavens being on fire shall be dissolved, and the elements shall melt with fervent heat?” The heavens will be on fire: what else could he be talking about? It is the waster of Zechariah, flesh consuming away while they stand upon their feet.

We hear all this and say, okay, great, but it should move us. What manner of persons ought we to be? In all holiness and godliness. Paul says the same: “Therefore let us not sleep, as do others; but let us watch and be sober.” Sober means don't drink of the mark of the beast, don't drink her wine, don't be so asleep that you think you're an American and nothing is going to touch you. God has not appointed us to wrath; he does not want his elect to be part of that death and destruction.

Looking for and hasting unto that day means you should be able to look boldly and say, I'm looking for it and I want it to come quickly. It is not the time to be divided in BS and simple issues, but to come together stronger and more united, growing in faith and understanding and applying it.

Don't worry that this place is going to be burned away: “Nevertheless we, according to his promise, look for new heavens and a new earth, wherein dwelleth righteousness.” That fire is a baptism by fire that cleanses all the evil and reforms the earth so it is fit for our new forms and for the new kingdom. Thy will be done in earth as it is in heaven: the kingdom is coming down, and this place has to be transformed.

precepts.label: Job 9:24
precepts.why:
“The burden of the word of the Lord to Israel by Malachi.” “I loved Jacob, And I hated Esau, and laid his mountains and his heritage waste”. That is what Paul refers to in Romans 9 when he says, as it is written. Esau went through some things at different times: they became the cavemen, came out of the caves and started taking people's identity, the fugitives and vagabonds that they were. But his ultimate, permanent judgment was deferred for a set time. “Whereas Edom saith, We are impoverished, but we will return and build the desolate places”, and during the Renaissance they did. “They shall build, but I will throw down; and they shall call them, The border of wickedness, and, The people against whom the Lord hath indignation for ever.”

Job shows why he has the power for now: “The earth is given into the hand of the wicked: he covereth the faces of the judges thereof; if not, where, and who is he?” The border of wickedness is the mark; people will know. And the indignation for ever tells you judgment was reserved for him, but God needed to use him for a time for his plan.

If not, who is he? If it is not Esau, if it is not the United States of America, who is it? The prophets saw visions of rooms like this: the president seated up high with the vice president and the speaker beside him, and the United Nations the same on a bigger scale, all the nations with their hierarchies on one accord. That is why the scriptures say they were confederate.

The destruction is held back until the servants of God are sealed. When the 144,000 are sealed, the winds are let go, the nations gather for war, and after that tribulation the Son of man comes in the clouds of heaven.

precepts.label: Isaiah 8:16
precepts.why:
In Revelation 7 another angel ascends from the east “having the seal of the living God”, and the destruction is held back “till we have sealed the servants of our God in their foreheads.” What is the seal of the living God?

It is not the hexagram. Many of us thought so years ago when we were young. Isaiah says what it is: “Bind up the testimony, seal the law among my disciples.” The seal of the living God is the law, bound up and sealed among his disciples. Pay attention, because if you blink you might miss it.

So the servants sealed in their foreheads are the ones with the law of God in their minds: “an hundred and forty and four thousand of all the tribes of the children of Israel.” When they are sealed, the four winds are loosed and the end comes. That is why this gospel, the law and the testimony, has to be preached in all the world for a witness: to seal the 144,000 before the end.

precepts.label: Isaiah 66:19-21
precepts.why:
Remember, the 144,000 have to be sealed, and then the end comes. Isaiah shows what they do: “And I will set a sign among them, and I will send those that escape of them unto the nations”. Those that escape are the 144,000. He sends them “to Tarshish”, Spain; “Pul”, Libya; “and Lud, that draw the bow, to Tubal”, Turkey; “and Javan”, the Grecian islands; “to the isles afar off, that have not heard my fame, neither have seen my glory”.

There will be people who have not heard the fame of the Lord and have not seen his glory: Israelites who have not heard or seen anything, and we have to go get them. “And they shall declare my glory among the Gentiles.” That is “this gospel of the kingdom shall be preached in all the world for a witness unto all nations”.

You might think that is talking about now. The next verse clears it up: “And they shall bring all your brethren for an offering unto the Lord out of all nations upon horses, and in chariots, and in litters, and upon mules, and upon swift beasts, to my holy mountain Jerusalem”. Jerusalem is already established as holy. Is Jerusalem holy today? No, there are bombs and missiles going off there. So this is not now; the kingdom is already set up.

“And I will also take of them for priests and for Levites, saith the Lord.” The brothers gathered from among those nations, the Lord will make them priests and Levites. With that, Matthew 24:14 gives a deeper understanding: the gospel preached in all the world is the work of the 144,000, and once they are sealed, the end comes.

thread.label: Matthew 24:9-15
thread.text: Then shall they deliver you up to be afflicted, and shall kill you: and ye shall be hated of all nations for my name’s sake.

precepts.label: Revelation 7:1-4
precepts.why:
“And this gospel of the kingdom shall be preached in all the world for a witness unto all nations; and then shall the end come.” Some say that contradicts Isaiah 66, where the Lord gathers his people out of the nations. It does not. The world Christ speaks of here goes into the 144,000, and Revelation 7 shows it.

“I saw four angels standing on the four corners of the earth, holding the four winds of the earth, that the wind should not blow on the earth, nor on the sea, nor on any tree.” The four winds are destruction. The earth is the armies on land; the sea is the navy and the marines; any tree is the air force, which comes down above the trees.

“And I saw another angel ascending from the east, having the seal of the living God”. The seal of the living God is the law: “Bind up the testimony, seal the law among my disciples.” That is what the angel is looking for.

Verse three is the point that ties in with Matthew 24: “Hurt not the earth, neither the sea, nor the trees, till we have sealed the servants of our God in their foreheads.” Do not let the destruction come until the servants of God are sealed. “And there were sealed an hundred and forty and four thousand of all the tribes of the children of Israel.”

Once the 144,000 are sealed, then shall the end come: destruction upon destruction upon destruction. And because the 144,000 are scattered among the nations, the gospel must be preached among all the nations. That is why we must go out and prophesy and teach among all these different nations: our people are there.

precepts.label: 2 Esdras 13:5
precepts.why:
Revelation 7 shows four angels holding back the four winds of the earth. What is the wind? Ezra gives the precept: “And after this I beheld, and, lo, there was gathered together a multitude of men, out of number, from the four winds of the heaven, to subdue the man that came out of the sea”.

A multitude of men out of number, coming from the four winds of heaven. The winds are the armies of the nations gathering, and the destruction they bring. They come “to subdue the man that came out of the sea”: to subdue Christ. They want to fight Christ, the Son of God.

That goes back to Daniel 8:25, where they stand up against the Prince of princes, but he is broken without hand. It is saying the same thing.

So when the angels hold the four winds so that they blow not on the earth, the sea or any tree, they are holding back the armies of the nations, on land, on sea and in the air, until the servants of God are sealed. Then the winds are let loose, the nations gather to fight Christ at his coming, and the end comes.

precepts.label: Isaiah 8:16
precepts.why:
In Revelation 7 another angel ascends from the east “having the seal of the living God”, and he cries to the four angels, “Hurt not the earth, neither the sea, nor the trees, till we have sealed the servants of our God in their foreheads.” What is the seal of the living God?

Isaiah answers: “Bind up the testimony, seal the law among my disciples.” The seal is the law, the commandments. That is what the angel is looking for, and that is what he is doing: sealing the law among the disciples, the servants of God, in their foreheads, meaning in their minds.

The ones sealed are “an hundred and forty and four thousand of all the tribes of the children of Israel.” When they are sealed with the law, the destruction is let loose and the end comes.

So the gospel of the kingdom preached in all the world for a witness is the law and the testimony going out to our people scattered among the nations, sealing them before the end. He that endures to the end, keeping it, the same shall be saved.

thread.label: Matthew 24:29-31
thread.text: Immediately after the tribulation of those days shall the sun be darkened, and the moon shall not give her light, and the stars shall fall from heaven, and the powers of the heavens shall be shaken:

precepts.label: Isaiah 34:4-5
precepts.why:
“Immediately after the tribulation of those days”: the churches argue about a seven-year dispensation, pre-trib and post-trib, and say the church is not going through tribulation. They do not know the Bible. Those who are alive must and will go through tribulation. Then “the stars shall fall from heaven”: missiles, rockets. “And the powers of the heavens shall be shaken”: that is war. Notice it says heavens, plural; it is not talking about the sky. What powers of the heavens?

Isaiah shows it: “And all the host of heaven shall be dissolved, and the heavens shall be rolled together as a scroll”, the mushroom effect. “And all their host shall fall down, as the leaf falleth off from the vine, and as a falling fig from the fig tree”: missiles and rockets falling.

“For my sword shall be bathed in heaven”. Christ said his sword would be bathed in heaven, so what heaven is he going to bathe his sword in? “Behold, it shall come down upon Idumea, and upon the people of my curse, to judgment.” Idumea is the so-called white man, the leading race on the planet. The powers of the heavens shaken is the war with Idumea, all these Edomite nations.

So Christ comes back for war, not only to save. The order is tribulation, then war between the nations, then the sign of the Son of man. The gap may be five years, as World War II was once America entered, or seven; it does not say.

precepts.label: Isaiah 45:4
precepts.why:
“And he shall send his angels with a great sound of a trumpet, and they shall gather together his elect from the four winds, from one end of heaven to the other.” Who is the elect? Not everybody.

Isaiah says: “For Jacob my servant’s sake, and Israel mine elect”. We are the elect. Israel is the elect. Not the Baptist church, and not all races on the planet.

And it is from the four winds, from one end of heaven to the other, because Isaiah 66 already showed there are Israelites scattered in the isles afar off who have not heard his fame nor seen his glory, and we have to go get them.

Before that gathering, “then shall all the tribes of the earth mourn”. It is going to be a happy day, but we will be crying and fearful too. And it comes only after the tribulation. Christ is not returning this year or next year; bad things have to happen first and we have to be proven. Not being able to pay your light bill is not tribulation. We are too comfortable, still smoking weed, going to the club, defiling the Sabbath, the women dressed like hoes with no clothes; in their affliction they will seek him, and the affliction has not even begun.

precepts.label: Luke 21:25-28
precepts.why:
Luke tells the same coming, and shows where we are in it. “And there shall be signs in the sun”, like a solar eclipse, “and in the moon”, blood moons and lunar eclipses, “and in the stars; and upon the earth distress of nations”: we are seeing that now. “With perplexity”: perplexity means confusion. “The sea and the waves roaring”: the nations roaring.

“Men’s hearts failing them for fear, and for looking after those things which are coming on the earth: for the powers of heaven shall be shaken.” That is war. “And then shall they see the Son of man coming in a cloud with power and great glory.” Right now we are in verse 25 going into the top part of verse 26.

“And when these things begin to come to pass”: the signs in the sun, the moon and the stars, the distress of nations with perplexity. “Then look up, and lift up your heads; for your redemption draweth nigh.” We are supposed to be looking up and lifting up our heads, knowing redemption is soon to come.

But we know the order of what is going to happen: tribulation, war, then Christ. So this is our time to clean ourselves up and get right with the Lord, because the time is drawing close.

precepts.label: Isaiah 66:15-16
precepts.why:
When Christ comes after the tribulation and the war, he does not come only to gather; he comes to judge. Isaiah shows it: “For, behold, the Lord will come with fire, and with his chariots like a whirlwind, to render his anger with fury, and his rebuke with flames of fire.”

“For by fire and by his sword will the Lord plead with all flesh: and the slain of the Lord shall be many.” All flesh. The slain of the Lord shall be many, and that is not just Esau. The wicked Israelites too.

That is why Christ is not coming tomorrow to rapture a comfortable church out of trouble. He comes with fire and sword against the nations of Idumea, and against every wicked one, including our own people who keep smoking, clubbing, and defiling the Sabbath. The powers of the heavens are shaken, his sword is bathed in heaven, and only his elect, Jacob and Israel who repented and endured, are gathered from the four winds.

precepts.label: Ezekiel 28:25
precepts.why:
Christ said the angels “shall gather together his elect from the four winds”. Ezekiel shows who does the gathering and from where: “Thus saith the Lord God; When I shall have gathered the house of Israel from the people among whom they are scattered”.

When who? The Lord God. The house of Israel is gathered from among the people where they are scattered: from the nations, from the four winds. So what is Netanyahu talking about? What are the not-so-Israelis over there talking about? The gathering is God's, and it is out of the nations, not a state set up by men.

“And shall be sanctified in them in the sight of the heathen, then shall they dwell in their land that I have given to my servant Jacob.” Only when God has gathered them do they dwell in the land he gave to Jacob.

That is also the answer when someone on the street brings up Revelation 7:9 and the great multitude out of all nations: it is the house of Israel, gathered from among the people where they were scattered, the elect of Isaiah 45, “Jacob my servant’s sake, and Israel mine elect”.

classes.title: The Real Reason Iran Was Attacked

precepts.label: 2 Esdras 5:1-5
precepts.why:
Christ said the sun would be darkened and the stars would fall from heaven before the sign of the Son of man appears. Ezra shows the same end, and it goes into the land of Israel and those who call themselves Jews and are not being destroyed.

“The days shall come, that they which dwell upon earth shall be taken in a great number”. That is the third woe: billions of people are going to die. “And the way of truth shall be hidden”: who the Israelites are, who the people of that land are, is hidden. “And the land shall be barren of faith. But iniquity shall be increased above that which now thou seest, or that thou hast heard long ago.” You see how wicked this world is getting; that was prophesied.

“And the land, that thou seest now to have root, shalt thou see wasted suddenly.” The land that has root now is the land of Israel, and it will be destroyed suddenly by the Persians and the Arabs. That goes back to the destruction at noonday. Wasted is the word Isaiah uses: “I have created the waster to destroy.” Seeing the land wasted means nuclear bombs.

“But if the most High grant thee to live, thou shalt see after the third trumpet”: in Revelation the third trump is nuclear war. “That the sun shall suddenly shine again in the night”: a nuclear bomb going off at night looks like the sun shining. That is what the prophet saw. “And the moon thrice in the day”: three bombs going off in the day, at Ekron, Ashdod and Ashkelon. “And blood shall drop out of wood”.

That is why Iran was attacked: they are trying to stop prophecy, or slow it down. But God's counsel shall stand. Iran will develop nuclear warheads, the Arabs will unite, and they will be brought down in the valley of Jehoshaphat. The day of the Lord will not come on us as a thief, because we are watching the signs.

thread.text: For from within, out of the heart of men, proceed evil thoughts, adulteries, fornications, murders,

precepts.label: Acts 5:1-3
precepts.why:
Christ said evil thoughts, adulteries, fornications, murders and the rest come “from within, out of the heart of men”, and “defile the man.” So how do those evil things get into your mind? Remember who the war is against: Satan. Acts shows how he does it.

“But a certain man named Ananias, with Sapphira his wife, sold a possession, And kept back part of the price, his wife also being privy to it, and brought a certain part, and laid it at the apostles' feet. But Peter said, Ananias, why hath Satan filled thine heart to lie to the Holy Ghost” What did Satan do? He filled his heart to lie. That lying spirit comes from Satan.

That is how he works. He is there in your head, whispering thoughts, tempting you, putting things there that are not there. The deacon says something to you and Satan says, why did he say that to you? The deacon don't like you. A husband gives his wife an order to clean the bathroom, and Satan whispers: you going to let him talk to you like that, after all you do in this house? He don't understand you; he don't love you. If she listens, she becomes bitter and it shows in her actions.

Satan puts things in everyone's head, the deacon included. The fight with Satan starts first and foremost in your mind, and many fall in this truth because they wait until the mind is already defiled. To win, you have to kill it right there: the thoughts Satan puts in your mind should never become action. Ask, why am I thinking like this? Fast and pray, Lord take these thoughts out of my mind, and answer him with the word of God, “the sword of the Spirit”, the weapon we fight with.

thread.label: Mark 8:36
thread.text: For what shall it profit a man, if he shall gain the whole world, and lose his own soul?

precepts.label: Isaiah 9:6
precepts.why:
“For what shall it profit a man, if he shall gain the whole world, and lose his own soul?” He was so lustful and covetous for the petty things this world provides that he loses his soul: he does not get the kingdom. You had a million gazillion dollars and still could not pay your way into heaven. Then Christ says, “Whosoever therefore shall be ashamed of me and of my words”, and Isaiah shows who those words belong to.

“For unto us a child is born, unto us a son is given: and the government shall be upon his shoulder: and his name shall be called Wonderful, Counsellor.” That child is Christ, and these are his titles. Stop right there: Counsellor. Christ is the ultimate counselor. The counsel for everything you are dealing with in this world, in this captivity, is already here in his words.

But you despise Christ's words, brothers and sisters. You don't even want to pick up your Bible and read four chapters, or pick up the precept packet to learn how to move this weapon. You are ashamed that Christ, the ultimate physician, has the fix for you. You can't get this counsel on a damn white man's couch. You can't go to Dr. Phil and expect him to fix your life. Them demons can't fix your life; they destroy homes. And Christ's counsel is free. How is it black people love free stuff, but when Christ gives it to you for free, you deny it?

Some purposely avoid the counselors in the truth because they have itching ears, and go to those as new as themselves, because they don't want to hear: fix your house, stop watching porn, delete the apps, get a flip phone, stop hanging with the same folks. Whoever is ashamed of the Counsellor's words, the laws, statutes and commandments, the blueprint to get out of this demonic land, Christ will be ashamed of him when he comes in the glory of his Father.

thread.label: Mark 13:33-34
thread.text: Take ye heed, watch and pray: for ye know not when the time is.

precepts.label: Psalms 35:1
precepts.why:
Christ said, “Take ye heed, watch and pray: for ye know not when the time is.” You don't know when the time is coming, so you need to stay prepared, stay ready. The prophecy is unfolding before our eyes: the ten horns giving their kingdoms to the beast, NATO sending weapons and troops here and there, and a time coming when those horns will hate the whore.

So what do we pray for? David shows us: “Plead my cause, O Lord, with them that strive with me: fight against them that fight against me.” Watch and pray for protection and deliverance, asking the Lord to fight against them that fight against us.

Watch and pray that none of us drift, get isolated, or get taken by sin and deception. You can pray for that. These Black Christians don't know what to pray for, but the scripture shows you: pray for the Lord to plead our cause against them that strive with us.

precepts.label: Luke 21:36
precepts.why:
“Take ye heed, watch and pray”, and Christ tells us what to watch and pray for: “Watch ye therefore, and pray always, that ye may be accounted worthy to escape all these things that shall come to pass, and to stand before the Son of man.”

Watch and pray for the destruction of their wicked devices: that the traps, the plots and the lies of the enemy be exposed and broken. Ask the Most High to show you.

Pray for prophecy to be fulfilled. And pray that you are worthy to stand before Christ when these things come. We see all this unfolding, the nations moving and the empire declining, so the prayer is not for these things to be stopped but for us to be found worthy to escape them and stand before the Son of man.

precepts.label: 1 Peter 4:7-8
precepts.why:
Christ said to watch and pray, “for ye know not when the time is.” Peter says the same: “But the end of all things is at hand: be ye therefore sober, and watch unto prayer.” Be sober, man. Keep a clear mind.

“And above all things have fervent charity among yourselves: for charity shall cover the multitude of sins.” Fervent charity is the brotherly love we are supposed to have for one another, the way we are supposed to treat one another.

We need it because these things are taking place, and we see them taking place on the earth. The end of all things is at hand, so watching and praying goes together with a clear mind and with love among ourselves.

precepts.label: Colossians 4:2
precepts.why:
Watching and praying is not only for the nation at large. “Continue in prayer, and watch in the same with thanksgiving”. Watch and pray for your household, your children, your brothers and sisters, because if the house fails, the nation gets weaker.

That is why marriage classes keep coming up. The scripture says it is not good for man to be alone. Some brothers think they are strong enough to do it without her, but it is not good that you should be alone; two are better than one.

And watch in the same with thanksgiving: be thankful for the things you have right now, because some people are in a way worse position than you. So continue in prayer, be thankful, and keep preparing, because you do not know when the time is.

precepts.label: Romans 8:28
precepts.why:
“But even the very hairs of your head are all numbered. Fear not therefore: ye are of more value than many sparrows.” Every hair on your head is numbered, so nothing can happen to you unless the Lord allows it. Don't be living and rolling in fear, and don't be scared of no damn ICE. A man's going is of the Lord. The spirit of Christ dwells in you; you are valuable.

Paul adds, “And we know that all things work together for good to them that love God.” If you love God, whatever happens, even bad things in your life, happens for good. When Aquila and Priscilla were deported, it was for good: they ended up as Paul's helpers teaching the gospel. God had a plan for them.

“To them who are the called according to his purpose.” Every last one of us is called according to God's purpose. None of us knows where our going is or what the Lord has planned for us, but he has a purpose for each of us.

A brother in France was told to stop teaching the word of God or leave. He would not stop, so they labelled him an extremist, refused to renew his papers, and deported him. Right now he is in Ghana, doing good, all praises to the Lord. So don't think papers, a green card or citizenship will protect you; laws are being set up to take them away from those who speak against America or Christianity. If they take your green card and send you back, it is what it is, of the Lord. Don't run, don't cry and lose your dignity; make preparation, and go over there and teach the word, because all things work together for good to them that love God.

thread.label: John 8:32
thread.text: And ye shall know the truth, and the truth shall make you free.

precepts.label: Psalms 119:142
precepts.why:
“And ye shall know the truth, and the truth shall make you free.” What is that truth? David answers: “Thy righteousness is an everlasting righteousness, and thy law is the truth.” The Lord's righteousness is everlasting; it is not going to cease, and with it comes the kingdom. And his law, the commandments of our heavenly Father, is the truth.

There is nothing else on the face of the planet that holds truth in it except the Bible, except the commandments of God. Hermeneutics does not do it. The damn Trinity does not do it. You damn scoffers online do not have the answer. It is the laws of God that have the truth.

And the ye who shall know it is not the whole world, not the good old white man, not the Hamite. It is the Israelites, the twelve tribes. The truth makes them free from the oppressive state and from the mentality many of us still hang on to, even inside these doors. It makes you free from Christmas, Halloween, Mother's Day and white Jesus. It makes you free from the hard bondage you serve in this spiritual warfare.

The truth is our weapon, a weapon of mass destruction. It defeats all the opposition we face day to day in our captivity, and as the word goes out, the angels are activated and time is speeding up, because the prophets are back on the face of the planet. That is why the Bishop tells you to read your four chapters a day, to become acclimated to this truth, this glorious gospel, your glorious history.

It says the truth shall make you free. It did not say it might. But you must study, pray and apply it before you can wield this sword, and it is also a weapon against the inward man you still battle with, the old man you have not purged. A brother knows how to pick up a Glock 17 and how to sell drugs, but cannot stay awake through four chapters a day. The law is the truth, and it is what unshackles the spiritual chains on our brains. Kill that old man with it, or be killed serving him.

precepts.label: Jeremiah 9:2
precepts.why:
Jeremiah cries, “Oh that I had in the wilderness a lodging place of wayfaring men; that I might leave my people, and go from them! for they be all adulterers, an assembly of treacherous men.” As these times come to pass, we have to strive to be among each other and to separate ourselves from these other nations and from the unbelievers, because they will continue to come for us.

That lodging place is what the believers in Acts 2 had. “All that believed were together, and had all things common”, and they “sold their possessions and goods, and parted them to all men, as every man had need.” Nothing was lacking among them. They were on one accord, breaking bread from house to house, on one accord with their finances, making sure no one who was lacking was left in a constraint. “And the Lord added to the church daily such as should be saved.”

What the Lord wants us to set up in these last days is a righteous underground railroad: looking out for the believers, the ones striving and getting themselves together. That means being selfless instead of selfish. It does not mean sell your last. It means that if you have excess, start consolidating, because this place is over.

Too many are still running up their credit cards and putting everything in debt, not realizing the tribulation that is coming. As the tribulation happens we have to align ourselves with what the Lord is telling us to do: come out from among the adulterers and treacherous men, and make a lodging place for the believers.

thread.label: Acts 3:19
thread.text: Repent ye therefore, and be converted, that your sins may be blotted out, when the times of refreshing shall come from the presence of the Lord;

classes.title: The Bottle, the Battle, and the Bible

precepts.label: Ecclesiasticus 21:2
precepts.why:
“Repent ye therefore, and be converted, that your sins may be blotted out”. We have to repent as a nation, and in the context of this class, repent from alcoholism. You have to stop. It is not something you can play with. You cannot play with sin.

That is why God says, “Flee from sin as from the face of a serpent: for if thou comest too near it, it will bite thee”. It will bite you. You do not stand close to a serpent and see how long you can last; you flee from it.

“The teeth thereof are as the teeth of a lion, slaying the souls of men.” That is sin. It is going into the sins you know you deal with. You know which particular sins you struggle with, and yet you still entertain them.

Deacon Joshua said it: you should be able to go six months. Just drop it for six months. Especially you big brothers: drop the alcohol for six months and watch how fast you get in the green, because every week you take away 4,000 calories. To repent and be converted is to flee from the bottle, not to keep it near and hope it does not bite.

Paul and Barnabas went about “Confirming the souls of the disciples, and exhorting them to continue in the faith, and that we must through much tribulation enter into the kingdom of God.” The tribulation hasn't fully started; you see it on a certain scale, but it will intensify. It will get worse, and worse, and worse.

Micah says how to go through it: “Be in pain, and labour to bring forth, O daughter of Zion, like a woman in travail”. The Bible says to be in pain. Pain is coming, and it has already begun; pay attention to what Trump and these people are doing. But whatever pain you go through, you still have to labour, labouring in this truth.

“for now shalt thou go forth out of the city, and thou shalt dwell in the field, and thou shalt go even to Babylon”. Where are we living today? Babylon: Mystery Babylon the Great, the United States of America.

Why does it say like a woman in travail? Because the pain comes and it goes, and when the baby is close to coming the pains increase and get worse and worse. That is what you see taking place now. Whether this society has another ten or twenty years, as the time draws nearer the pains will increase: the affliction rising against those of us that fear God. Keep labouring through them.

That is why the brother who is not studying and applying the scriptures has no root and will not survive it; when things get real he will be offended, scared, and go back into the world. Sisters, a brother who never teaches and is never in a camp video is a gamble.

precepts.label: Revelation 12:17

Much tribulation is coming, and Revelation shows where it comes from: “And the dragon was wroth with the woman”. The dragon is the beast, the white man, Esau. According to the prophecy they will be angry at us, “and went to make war with the remnant of her seed”.

Why? Not because we are evil or terrorists, but because we “keep the commandments of God, and have the testimony of Jesus Christ.” The testimony of Jesus Christ is everything written in this book, everything the prophets said would happen, everything written about who the wicked are and all the evil the so-called white man is doing. That testimony says these people are the synagogue of Satan, and that God is bringing judgment on them for all their evil on the earth. As you teach it, they get angry and make war with us.

So do not think we will be out there teaching the Bible and everything will be good. The tribulation will be attacks from the government: labelling us a hate group, lying on us, putting us in prison, hitting your pocket and your food, attacking your wife and your children, because those are the things we care about. In the end they will force idol worship: worship the beast, or you can't buy, sell, work, get a job or go to the doctor.

The dragon is wroth, and he will make war with us. That is the much tribulation through which we must enter into the kingdom of God, and why we must be exhorted to continue in the faith.

precepts.why:
When Paul came to Corinth he “found a certain Jew named Aquila, born in Pontus, lately come from Italy, with his wife Priscilla; (because that Claudius had commanded all Jews to depart from Rome:)”. Rome commanded all the Israelites to leave. That is mass deportation, the same thing Claudius Caesar did back then that you see happening today with Trump and the ICE raids, and they are not raiding Europeans; they are going after the black and Hispanic communities.

But look what Aquila and Priscilla did after they were deported. They sailed with Paul into Syria, evangelizing and doing the work. When they heard Apollos, who only knew John, they “took him unto them, and expounded unto him the way of God more perfectly.” And Paul writes, “Greet Priscilla and Aquila my helpers in Christ Jesus: Who have for my life laid down their own necks”. That brother and his wife were not regular to Paul: they put their own heads on the chopping block for him.

The deportation was a divine mission. The Lord set them up to meet Paul, to teach Apollos, and to help spread the gospel. So don't be scared of no damn ICE. A man's going is of the Lord, and if they take your green card or your citizenship and send you back, it is of the Lord. Brother Nehemiah was deported from France for refusing to stop teaching, labelled an extremist, and now he is doing good in Ghana.

“But even the very hairs of your head are all numbered. Fear not therefore: ye are of more value than many sparrows.” Nothing can happen to you unless the Lord allows it. “And we know that all things work together for good to them that love God, to them who are the called according to his purpose.” Even the bad things happen for good, as the deportation did for Aquila and Priscilla. God has a purpose for every last one of us.

Waking out of sleep means not letting fear keep you from doing what Christ commanded. “Now is our salvation nearer than when we believed”, and a mind given power, love and soundness by God is ready for what is coming.

precepts.label: 1 Peter 5:8

Waking out of sleep means staying awake: “Be sober, be vigilant; because your adversary the devil, as a roaring lion, walketh about, seeking whom he may devour”.

You have to stay sober and vigilant, because the enemy looks for open doors and distracted people. As soon as one of y’all gets distracted from the mission, they are coming. That is why every time somebody leaves, we see who shows up: the damn Christian apologists.

They are just trying to destroy what we are doing. They are not trying to save your soul. They say they are already saved; they are not saved from the nuclear missiles that are about to drop.

So the one who is asleep is the one the roaring lion devours. It is high time to wake up, stay sober, stay vigilant and stay on the mission, because the adversary is walking about looking for whoever drifts.

Christ said more in the same chapter: “For there shall arise false Christs, and false prophets”. That is going to happen, and those who are spiritually asleep will be the ones deceived.

So awaking out of sleep is guarding your mind from deception. The time is late, our salvation is nearer than when we believed, and the deceivers are already here. Take heed.

A pastor once challenged the captain, fat as hell, saying he eats people like him up for dinner. Since he started with dinner, the answer was gluttony: about thirty scriptures of correction on his own church page. Not a debate about the color of Christ first; deal with your health right now.

You have to get out here and work out. You are not getting any younger, and your body is the temple: you must be fit to serve.

precepts.label: 1 Corinthians 14:33

Paul also says: “For God is not the author of confusion, but of peace, as in all churches of the saints.” Prepare ye war physically, and keep your house in order, because God is not the author of confusion, and order protects in a crisis.

When this empire collapses and global trade is disrupted, the ones who are ready will be the ones whose bodies are strong and whose houses are in order. A body kept under control and a house kept in order is how we glorify God in the body he bought with a price.

precepts.label: Psalms 136:8-17
precepts.why:
Paul says God “will not suffer you to be tempted above that ye are able; but will with the temptation also make a way to escape”. There is no temptation that should derail us from inheriting the wide place, the kingdom that sits within the narrow passage (2 Esdras 7), because God's mercies endure for ever. David shows that mercy: “The sun to rule by day: for his mercy endureth for ever: The moon and stars to rule by night: for his mercy endureth for ever.” The Lord declared the end from the beginning and created all of this. We acknowledge his greatness and his mercy, and we tap into that comfort under the shadow of his wings.

“To him that smote Egypt in their firstborn: for his mercy endureth for ever: And brought out Israel from among them”. The Most High killed our enemies for us because he had mercy on us. We cried in Egypt, the Lord heard our cries and said, go down, Moses, tell Pharaoh to let my people go, or I will kill his firstborn.

“With a strong hand, and with a stretched out arm”, “To him which divided the Red sea into parts”, “And made Israel to pass through the midst of it”, “But overthrew Pharaoh and his host in the Red sea”, “To him which led his people through the wilderness”, “To him which smote great kings: for his mercy endureth for ever”.

We saw all of this, and we still get here today and do evil, just as our fathers under the cloud did. The Most High is trying to set us back up, but he wants to make sure we are in the right spiritual posture to inherit the kingdom. He lets us use his Bible as spiritual weapons to fight off the evil temptations so we can get to the wide.

precepts.label: Lamentations 3:20-24
precepts.why:
Paul says the things that happened to our fathers “are written for our admonition”. Jeremiah shows how we hold on to them: “My soul hath them still in remembrance, and is humbled in me.” The them is the afflictions and punishments we are supposed to remember for breaking God's commandments in the past, and we are humbled because of it.

“This I recall to my mind, therefore have I hope. It is of the Lord’s mercies that we are not consumed, because his compassions fail not.” Do you hear that? That is the love the Lord has for us, his mercy enduring for ever. He loves you, sisters; he loves you, brothers. His compassions and his mercies fail not.

“They are new every morning: great is thy faithfulness.” His mercies are renewed every day, forgiving us. We say the Lord's prayer, we ask the Lord for mercy and to forgive our transgressions, and he does it. And we are still playing with sin.

“The Lord is my portion, saith my soul; therefore will I hope in him.” So now we are in the posture where he has given us a way to escape the evil all around us.

precepts.label: Psalms 23:5
precepts.why:
God will with the temptation “make a way to escape, that ye may be able to bear it.” While we endure the encounters of temptation that are common to us all, even the temptations of our own lusts, the Lord prepares a table for us: “Thou preparest a table before me in the presence of mine enemies: thou anointest my head with oil; my cup runneth over.” Why? Because his mercies endure for ever.

The table is the Bible. Habakkuk shows it: “Write the vision, and make it plain upon tables”. Isaiah shows it: “write it before them in a table, and note it in a book”. The tables are what we are supposed to be reading.

But we read the tables and talk about what's going on overseas while our own spirit is rotten. We read it like entertainment instead of changing what is really going on in us.

Brothers and sisters, you are in the greatest place on the planet earth, and some of you don't even realize it. You are getting teaching that tells you what is happening in the future, because we know the future from reading the Bible. And some of you play games, scorn what is brought out, and take this for a joke. The table is prepared in the presence of our enemies; eat from it.

precepts.label: Habakkuk 2:2
precepts.why:
The table the Lord prepares before us in the presence of our enemies is the Bible. Habakkuk shows it: “And the Lord answered me, and said, Write the vision, and make it plain upon tables, that he may run that readeth it.”

The Lord told the prophet Habakkuk: since you want to get out of captivity, write the vision down, and make it plain upon the tables. That is what we are supposed to be reading.

Make it plain “that he may run that readeth it”: when we bring this out, everybody is going to be running, and we are going to run to teach it. The Bible is going to turn this whole system upside down: these are they which have turned the world upside down. But we have to be in it like that, not reading about overseas like entertainment while our own spirit is rotten.

precepts.label: Isaiah 30:8
precepts.why:
Paul says what happened to our fathers is “written for our admonition, upon whom the ends of the world are come.” Isaiah shows why it was written: “Now go, write it before them in a table, and note it in a book, that it may be for the time to come for ever and ever”.

This is to the wicked Israelites, us, our people. Go write it before them in a table, and put a note in the book about their wickedness, our wickedness, “that it may be for the time to come”: for today.

And it goes on: “That this is a rebellious people”. That is what is going on with our people; our people are rebellious. But the Bible is here to correct you and straighten you out. If you want it, there is a way for you to get it.

Those who refuse to learn from the past by reading it are doomed to repeat it. You will repeat it because you refuse to learn, and the same spirits will follow you and attach themselves to you, the way people move to a new town, a new job or a new congregation and the same problem follows. The Lord sends those spirits as a mirror to show you what is wrong in you. Learn it from the book, and you won't have to learn it again.

precepts.label: Exodus 20:3-5
precepts.why:
“Wherefore, my dearly beloved, flee from idolatry”. That is in the New Testament, for you black Christians, you black apologists, you black pastors who say the law is done away with. Why would Paul write it if the law was done away? Because it goes right back to Exodus 20: “Thou shalt have no other gods before me”.

“Thou shalt not make unto thee any graven image, or any likeness of any thing that is in heaven above, or that is in the earth beneath, or that is in the water under the earth: Thou shalt not bow down thyself to them, nor serve them: for I the Lord thy God am a jealous God, visiting the iniquity of the fathers upon the children unto the third and fourth generation of them that hate me”. That is where 1 Corinthians 10:14 comes from.

Valentine's Day is idolatry; its origin is Februus and Lupercalia, a fertility rite in which women presented themselves to be struck because it was believed to help with fertility. When you sit up there and celebrate Valentine's Day, you are putting Februus, whoever the hell that is, and Lupercalia before the Lord. What's wrong with Christmas? It's idolatry. Your birthday? Idolatry. Halloween? Idolatry. That's what's wrong with it.

The Lord gave us our own high holy days, in Leviticus 23. The Destruction of Nicanor began last night at sundown, the victory recorded in 1 Maccabees 7 and 2 Maccabees 14 and 15, when Judas Maccabeus defeated and killed Nicanor, the Seleucid Syrian Greek commander who came to crush Israel and threaten the temple. Tonight at sundown begins Purim, when we were saved from being wiped out in the Persian Empire: the enemy was Haman, and the deliverance came through Esther and Mordecai. Our enemies' holidays, the Fourth of July and Christmas, are victories over us. Ours are victories over our enemies. Flee from their idolatry and keep what the Lord gave us.

precepts.why:
“but rather that ye may prophesy”. The purpose of prophecy is to build your spirit up and prepare you for temptation and destruction. Prophecy is warning: thus saith the Lord. When you see these things come to pass, know that Esau, Edom, America, is the enemy the Bible speaks of.

Revelation 18 gives the warning plainly. Babylon the great is fallen and has become the habitation of devils, and the call goes out: “Come out of her, my people, that ye be not partakers of her sins, and that ye receive not of her plagues.”

Come out of religion. Come out of these doctrines. Come out of Christianity. Come out of the lies and philosophies and deceit, and repent. The Christian church has you clapping on a tambourine while the prophecy is fulfilled before your eyes; they say the book of Revelation is sealed and cannot explain any of this.

That is why we covet to prophesy: so our people can see who Babylon is, come out of her, and not receive her plagues when the fire comes on her.

precepts.label: Isaiah 47:1-3
precepts.why:
“Come down, and sit in the dust, O virgin daughter of Babylon, sit on the ground: there is no throne, O daughter of the Chaldeans”. The virgin daughter of Babylon is America. People try to say Babylon is somewhere else, but when has America been touched? The one thing that ever happened, they blew up themselves: 9/11 was the biggest controlled demolition anybody has ever witnessed. The virgin means she has not been touched, defiled or destroyed, until these prophecies are fulfilled. She is going to be touched.

“for thou shalt no more be called tender and delicate”. She thought she was tender and delicate, but that is coming to an end. As Daniel 2 showed, all manner of nations are within her, including her enemies: sleeper cells.

“Take the millstones, and grind meal: uncover thy locks, make bare the leg, uncover the thigh, pass over the rivers.” A virgin would be covered, but here her locks, leg and thigh are uncovered: the wickedness of Babylon, America, is being revealed.

“Thy nakedness shall be uncovered, yea, thy shame shall be seen: I will take vengeance, and I will not meet thee as a man.” What shame? How she allies herself with the little Satan and helps them bomb other countries, backing a demolition project to wipe out Gaza and its people, even renaming a whole body of water the Gulf of America. That is why the nations that benefited from her will grow to hate her, and prophecy lets us see it coming.

precepts.label: 2 Thessalonians 2:9-12
precepts.why:
“But if our gospel be hid, it is hid to them that are lost”. If you do not understand that Christ is a black man, that the children of the transatlantic slave trade are the Jews according to the Bible, and that Christ is coming to bring vengeance on all nations that oppress us, it is because you are lost. “In whom the god of this world hath blinded the minds of them which believe not”. Some say the god of this world is the spiritual demon Satan, but always start with his physical counterpart: the so-called white man, who creates these technologies and deceives the world physically. He blinds your mind with his mouth, that great mouth speaking lies and blasphemy.

Thessalonians shows how: “Even him, whose coming is after the working of Satan”. That is America, coming into power after the working of the spiritual demon Satan, “with all power and signs and lying wonders”: the technology, the media, social media. “And with all deceivableness of unrighteousness in them that perish; because they received not the love of the truth, that they might be saved.” You did not love this truth. You loved the white man and his lies, and you hate yourself.

“And for this cause God shall send them strong delusion, that they should believe a lie”. A delusion is a false belief or judgment about external reality, held despite incontrovertible evidence to the contrary. We show our people the evidence and it does not matter. The lies are that the white man is the Jew, when Christ called them the synagogue of Satan; that white people are the Christians, when the Christians were the Israelites that converted and followed Christ; that you can eat pork and shrimp; that Christ came and died for all nations. Christianity is under that delusion, and so are those who believe the people in the land of Israel are the Jews. They cannot come out unless God opens their eyes.

So God allows America to do crazy stuff on this earth, and uses it to wake his people up and break the spell of that strong delusion. “That they all might be damned who believed not the truth”: everyone that does not believe this truth will be damned, with no repentance. You can curse us and call us names; it is what it is.

precepts.label: Matthew 24:24
precepts.why:
“For there shall arise false Christs, and false prophets”. That is Christianity, what you see here today: the image of the beast, the white man coming and speaking lies in Christ's name. That is the god of this world blinding the minds of them which believe not.

“and shall shew great signs and wonders”: his technology. That is his mouth, the television, the Hollywood movies. Growing up we watched Captain America and GI Joe, the American heroes, and now the Avengers. All of it puts white people forward as what they are not. Those things were brainwashing us and messing with our minds.

“insomuch that, if it were possible, they shall deceive the very elect.” Is it possible for them to deceive the elect? No. The illusion and delusion is so strong that if it were possible, even the elect would have been taken. But it is not possible. That is why we are waking up today and see clearly. They cannot trick us or fool us; we are not under that delusion, though the whole world is.

This is the mouth of the dragon: social media and technology, used to monitor, control and deceive the people and put propaganda out there. Netanyahu and the Israeli government want to control social media to stop the truth from going forth, as they took down our pages before, and soon we will not be teaching on YouTube at all. But the elect cannot be deceived by that mouth, and God will make their own tongue fall upon themselves.

That is why Paul says “For though we walk in the flesh, we do not war after the flesh”. We walk in the physical, but we do not war after the physical. This is spiritual warfare. “For the weapons of our warfare are not carnal, but mighty through God to the pulling down of strong holds”. Our job is “Casting down imaginations, and every high thing that exalteth itself against the knowledge of God”, casting down every evil imagination in the mind of our people, “and bringing into captivity every thought to the obedience of Christ”, the black Messiah.

So get your mind right and get your mind together, so you can prepare for the second coming of Christ. No matter what happens in this place, do not get caught up in foolishness. If they can treat a white woman like that in Minnesota, imagine how they can treat us. Do not go out there talking about helping march. This is not your problem. Stay in the scripture.

Even your own family in the world, who tell you they hate the Most High, will call and pull you into their stupidity: that's my brother, that's my mama. Do not get caught up. Our job is to get our people ready for the second coming.

precepts.label: Psalms 85:11
precepts.why:
“For the weapons of our warfare are not carnal, but mighty through God to the pulling down of strong holds”. You are at war right now in your spirit, with evil temptations pushed on every front: family members, school, work, even your own thoughts as you sit here. The weapons are not guns; the weapons are the commandments of God, and they are mighty.

Mighty to pull down what? Lies. That is what the Bible does; that is how we tear the lies down. We open up the Bible and swallow up the lies, like it says in the Psalms: “Truth shall spring out of the earth; and righteousness shall look down from heaven.” We open this Bible, and the lies are swallowed up.

So “Casting down imaginations” is casting down lies, “and every high thing that exalteth itself against the knowledge of God”, and the knowledge of God is the law, the Bible. When you open this Bible and apply the commandments, you get rid of those impulsive, sinful thoughts and bring every thought “into captivity” under the obedience of Christ. That is how you walk straight past your temptation.

precepts.label: Ecclesiastes 8:11
precepts.why:
The weapons of our warfare are the commandments. You are supposed to answer your impulses, your sinful temptations, with the commandments of God, and that is supposed to turn you from the door of temptation. If you understood that death is around the corner, you would listen to these laws.

But the wicked man thinks judgment is far off: “Because sentence against an evil work is not executed speedily, therefore the heart of the sons of men is fully set in them to do evil.” Because the judgment is not immediate, his sick, evil mind is emboldened to commit evil and sin, and he leaves the commandments to the side. You had better recognize where you are.

That is the war inside you. The Lord isn't asking you to pick up a gun and go do something out there; he is asking you to get your mind right and set this mark in your head to change your behavior. We don't advocate anyone initiating aggression; if someone comes at you with a rope or a knife, you defend yourself. But the gung-ho brothers who can't wait for war can't even discipline their food. The war to win first is against the heart that sin makes bold.

precepts.label: 2 Esdras 14:13
precepts.why:
“And having in a readiness to revenge all disobedience, when your obedience is fulfilled.” Some of our people can't wait: they want to be part of the war in the streets, casting out demons, getting their names on the Saturday night specials: brother, get a good angle of me, I want my video to go up Saturday. But here's the stipulation: when your obedience is fulfilled. That means there is no impediment left in your spirit to commit sin; you are walking straight in your spirit, your household, with your children, blameless. Then you can go out and correct your people.

That is what the Apocrypha says: “Now therefore set thine house in order, and reprove thy people”. First set your house in order. Your physical house can't be set in order if your spiritual house, meaning your damn head, is not in order. You haven't even checked your own wicked thoughts, your own actions, your own temptations, and you are trying to correct your wife, your son and your daughter.

Set your head in order; then you can set your house in order; then you can reprove your people. That is when your obedience is fulfilled, and you can revenge all disobedience, because you checked it first within yourself. We want to play warrior, to look good, while there are demons all up in us that we have not corrected yet.

precepts.label: Acts 3:19
precepts.why:
“That ye put off concerning the former conversation the old man, which is corrupt according to the deceitful lusts”. The former conversation is the ways of this world, the love of this world. The old man, or old woman, is corrupt and filthy in the eyesight of the Lord, and that mentality manifests itself all the time. The ways of this world are deceitful lusts, hooks in your spirit that will take your soul out of the game. “And be renewed in the spirit of your mind”: by the scriptures. There must be change. That old man must be killed. If you are still the same three or four years in this truth, brothers and sisters, you need to really examine yourself; something is not right.

Acts shows the difference: “Repent ye therefore, and be converted, that your sins may be blotted out”. First repent: you stop your sin, you stop breaking the laws of God. Then be converted, which is the actions behind that. You have to have a pattern of righteousness to follow, a pattern of good works, not dabbling in your old sin.

You used to lie; you used to steal. You are not doing those any more. But now what are you doing? You are speaking uprightly to your brothers. You are working, because now you need a manner of provision to provide not only for yourself and your family but for your nation that depends on you. That is the converted part: the works that follow repentance, showing that you truly repented and are no longer that old man or that old woman.

So “put on the new man, which after God is created in righteousness and true holiness.” Put on the king that you are, and sisters, the attributes of your foremothers, the daughters of Sarah. Put away lying, “Let him that stole steal no more: but rather let him labour”, and let no corrupt communication proceed out of your mouth. If you are not investing in the scriptures, the old man will come out in wickedness.

precepts.label: Daniel 4:17
precepts.why:
Christ is “the image of the invisible God, the firstborn of every creature,” because we have not seen the Most High’s face nor His shape nor heard His voice. The Most High created Christ, and Christ created everything else: “whether they be thrones, or dominions, or principalities, or powers: all things were created by him, and for him.” For him means to do his will, for his glory. The nations are his sword, doing the Lord’s bidding by whipping Israel back to repentance.

Daniel shows who rules those thrones: “This matter is by the decree of the watchers, and the demand by the word of the holy ones: to the intent that the living may know that the most High ruleth in the kingdom of men.” There are kingdoms of men on every continent, in every country, town and village, but the Most High is ruling them.

“And giveth it to whomsoever he will.” The Lord determines who is that principality, who is that throne, who is that power. Christ is like a chess player moving all the pieces into place so that his will is done.

“And setteth up over it the basest of men”: the lowest of the low. You have to be low down to do what these nations have done to each other and to the nation of Israel. But we transgressed against the Lord, and He said, I have to teach you war. If all the powers were the nicest people on earth, there would be no war and no oppression, and nothing to learn. We have to fight to get back to where we are supposed to be. Brothers and sisters who send messages saying they are taking a break from IUIC are taking a break from the Lord, and that is not going to work.

precepts.label: 2 Esdras 16:38-39
precepts.why:
Paul says, “For when they shall say, Peace and safety; then sudden destruction cometh upon them, as travail upon a woman with child; and they shall not escape.” Peace and safety is what Trump keeps saying, the peace president who bombed Yemen, Somalia, Iraq, Iran, Syria, Nigeria and Venezuela. Some of you love it when the president talks about peace, stomping your feet because you think nothing is going to happen in this country. Ezra shows what travail upon a woman with child means.

“As when a woman with child in the ninth month bringeth forth her son, with two or three hours of her birth great pains compass her womb, which pains, when the child cometh forth, they slack not a moment.” Within two or three hours: in the time of nations that is two or three years, or months. When a woman is having a baby, her contractions come ten minutes apart, then five, six, five, four, closer and closer.

“Even so shall not the plagues be slack to come upon the earth, and the world shall mourn, and sorrows shall come upon it on every side.” A pain comes one month, then things calm down; another comes two or three months later, and things calm down again. That is how it is going to be in this world.

But when things calm down, Israelites say nothing is going to happen and go back to business as usual. That is why Paul says “of the times and the seasons, brethren, ye have no need that I write unto you.” We read the prophecies every week, and if you are not paying attention you will be caught off guard. The real brothers and the real sisters will not need to be warned; they are aware of what is about to happen.

precepts.label: 2 Esdras 6:9
precepts.why:
Thessalonians says the man of sin will be revealed: not elected, not raised up, but made known, because he was already ordained. Ezra shows it was planned before anything was made: “In the beginning, when the earth was made, before the borders of the world stood, or ever the winds blew,” before paradise, the angels and the firmament. “Then did I consider these things, and they all were made through me alone, and through none other: by me also they shall be ended, and by none other.” Like an artist who sees the work in his mind first, the Lord had it all planned before He started making anything.

Ezra asks, “What shall be the parting asunder of the times? or when shall be the end of the first, and the beginning of it that followeth?” The answer: “From Abraham unto Isaac, when Jacob and Esau were born of him, Jacob’s hand held first the heel of Esau. For Esau is the end of the world, and Jacob is the beginning of it that followeth.” You want to know when the end is? Esau is the end, and you have to watch the signs to understand when it comes. The judgment was deferred for a time, but Jacob is the beginning of what follows.

Some say Jacob stole the birthright and was at fault. But if this was set from the foundation of the world, as it was in Cain’s spirit to do what he did, Jacob was not wrong. Neither had done good or evil in the womb, as Romans 9 says; grabbing the heel was a reflex in the spirit and a sign for our learning. Jacob was always supposed to be in rulership, but it was for a time.

So the son of perdition reveals himself by exalting himself, opposing God and seeking worship in these last days. The spirit of Cain came through the seed of Esau and grew from murder of a brother, to weapon maker, to global oppressor.

precepts.label: John 17:12
precepts.why:
Thessalonians calls the man of sin “the son of perdition,” and Christ used that same name in his prayer: “While I was with them in the world, I kept them in thy name.” This is Christ speaking of the righteous, the elect, in this present world. He kept them in the Father’s name by ministering to them, giving them the word, magnifying the law, breaking down the divisions and showing how they were to be unified under the commandments in the faith of Christ.

“Those that thou gavest me I have kept, and none of them is lost.” The ones given to him are kept and sealed. John 17 has so many verses that smash the John 3:16 doctrine.

“But the son of perdition; that the scripture might be fulfilled.” The son of perdition is not kept; he is ordained for destruction. That goes with 2 Esdras 6:9-10: the elect are preserved so that the end, Esau, and then the beginning that follows, Jacob, can come to pass.

Through the process of time Cain elevated himself in his bloodline, putting in place institutions, banking and all the rest, and became a global power. Then comes 2 Thessalonians 2:8: that wicked revealed, “whom the Lord shall consume with the spirit of his mouth,” by the prophets preaching now, “and shall destroy with the brightness of his coming.”
